_meta.description: Ego item templates. Each entry describes modifiers applied to a base item when it rolls as "great" quality during generation. Fields: serial (MAngband ego index), name (suffix/prefix added to item name), rating (affects dungeon level "feeling" score), xtra (0=none, 1-3=random bonus pool), max_to_hit/dam/ac (max random bonus; not yet applied at runtime), pval (magnitude for stat/skill flags), depth/rarity/cost (generation parameters), applicable_types (tval+sval range filter), slots (derived equipment slots), item_categories (derived category), flags (MAngband flag strings).

xtra_pools.1: Random sustain: one of SUST_STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHR chosen at item generation

SPEED.desc: +pval to speed (each point = +10 speed above 110 base)

MIGHT.desc: +pval to launcher damage multiplier (e.g. Short Bow ×2 → ×3)

SUST_STR.desc: Prevents Strength from being drained by monster blows

RES_NEXUS.desc: Reduces nexus damage; prevents teleportation by monsters

RES_CHAOS.desc: Reduces chaos damage by ÷3; prevents hallucination

REGEN.desc: Doubles HP and mana regeneration rate

FREE_ACT.desc: Immunity to paralysis and slowing from monster blows

HOLD_LIFE.desc: Halves experience drain; sustains experience levels

TELEPATHY.desc: ESP: detects nearby monsters through walls

BLESSED.desc: Priests can wield without penalty; minor bonus to spells

ACTIVATE.desc: Item has a special activation effect (hardcoded per serial)

BRAND_ACID.desc: ×3 damage unless monster immune to acid

BRAND_ELEC.desc: ×3 damage unless monster immune to lightning

BRAND_FIRE.desc: ×3 damage unless monster immune to fire

BRAND_COLD.desc: ×3 damage unless monster immune to cold

BRAND_POIS.desc: ×3 damage unless monster immune to poison

IGNORE_ACID.desc: Item cannot be destroyed by acid

IGNORE_ELEC.desc: Item cannot be destroyed by lightning

IGNORE_FIRE.desc: Item cannot be destroyed by fire

IGNORE_COLD.desc: Item cannot be destroyed by cold

LIGHT_CURSE.desc: Light curse: item is cursed (removable by Remove Curse)

HEAVY_CURSE.desc: Heavy curse: requires Banishment or *Remove Curse*

AGGRAVATE.desc: Aggravates nearby monsters; wakes sleeping monsters

TELEPORT.desc: Random involuntary teleportation (1% chance per tick)

HIDE_TYPE.desc: Hides the stat type from the item name (e.g. Boots of Speed instead of Boots +10 SPEED)

SHOW_MODS.desc: Always shows to-hit/to-dam modifiers in the item name

runtime_notes.note: inert_flags are stored but have no runtime effect in current IronHell implementation (src/game/systems/character/resistances.ts flagsToAffixes does not map them). IGNORE_* are item preservation flags and may intentionally remain inert in a PvE context.

ego_items.name: of Slaying
ego_items.description: They boost your to-hit and to-dam values.

ego_items.name: of Accuracy
ego_items.description: It has no special abilities, but its to-hit value may be unusually high.

ego_items.name: of Power
ego_items.description: It has no special abilities, but its to-dam value may be unusually high.

ego_items.name: of Wounding
ego_items.description: Ammunition of Wounding often has unusually high to-hit and to-dam values.
